title: Project Research Scientist-III (Medical)
description: Last date of application: 20th July 2026 Applications Invited MAHAN Trust invites applications from eligible and motivated candidates for the position of Project Research Scientist-III (Medical) under the Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR) funded Implementation Research Project. Project Title Development of an Optimal Model for Sickle Cell Disease Screening, Diagnosis, Treatment and Care: An Implementation Research Model Implementing Institutions Dr. Panjabrao Alias Bhausaheb Deshmukh Memorial Medical College (Dr. PDMMC), Amravati MAHAN Trust Position Details Position: Project Research Scientist-III (Medical) Number of Posts: 01 Honorarium: ₹13,39,200/- per annum (approximately ₹1,11,600/- per month), as per ICMR norms, qualifications, merit, and relevant experience. Duration: three years Job Location: Mahatma Gandhi Tribal Hospital, Karmagram, Village Utavali, Tahsil Dharni (Melghat), District Amravati, Maharashtra – 444702. The position involves extensive field work throughout Amravati District. Key Responsibilities Lead and coordinate all activities of Field Team-1. Supervise and provide scientific guidance to all three field teams. Monitor day-to-day project implementation and review reports submitted by field staff. Train and mentor research personnel in research methodology and study procedures. Assist the Principal Investigator in preparing Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), technical reports, scientific manuscripts, and other project documents. Coordinate research-related administrative activities assigned by the Principal Investigator. Conduct community-based and hospital-based research activities. Ensure compliance with ICMR guidelines, ethical standards, and project protocols. Support implementation of the Government of India’s National Sickle Cell Elimination Mission. Essential Qualification MBBS or BDS with a Master of Public Health (MPH). Minimum three years of relevant experience in public health, clinical research, implementation research, or community-based research. Desirable Qualification Ph.D. in Public Health, Community Medicine, Epidemiology, or a related discipline. Experience in implementation research, tribal health, sickle cell disease programmes, scientific writing, and project management will be preferred. Selection Process Shortlisted candidates will be invited for a written test and/or personal interview. The decision of the Selection Committee shall be final. How to Apply Interested candidates should submit: Updated Curriculum Vitae (CV) Cover Letter Copies of educational qualifications Experience certificates Registration certificate (if applicable) Applications should be sent to: The Principal Investigator ICMR Implementation Research Project MAHAN Trust, Mahatma Gandhi Tribal Hospital, Karmagram, Village Utavali, Tahsil Dharni, District Amravati, Maharashtra – 444702 Email: hire@mahantrust.org Contact: 9225341260
